name: agentic-gamedev-pipeline
description: A bounded game-feature pipeline with director preflight, one persistent writing owner, parallel read-only convergence, risk-based review closure, and in-game QA.

interface.shortDescription: Preflight, one owner, parallel audits, review, and QA.
interface.longDescription: Turns approved feature documents into a production-ready candidate through resource/runtime preflight, one persistent writing owner, deterministic product/support/evidence revisions, parallel read-only convergence, risk-based Review closure, explicit worker budgets and execution gates, and feature-focused runtime QA.
defaultPrompt: Stabilize the product requirements for this game.
Run the bounded development pipeline from approved feature documents.
Run one persistent Engineer owner and aggregate parallel read-only convergence findings before remediation.
Recover support or test-only Review findings without restarting runtime convergence.
Use targeted closure for local fixes, then run feature-focused in-game QA.
